body.message:
As per your request, please find the rates for Miraclz By Danube

September: AED 11,500
October: AED 13,500

Please note that a security deposit of AED 3,000 is required. The booking will be on a monthly basis only (30 nights each month).

If you wish to block the unit for 08 months we need to have the 1st and the last month payment in advance along with the security deposit

Thank you.
